Israel asked the Lord who should go first. How do you seek God's direction?
Judah could not drive out some inhabitants. What happens when we stop short of full obedience?
Tribe after tribe failed to drive out the Canaanites. What compromises creep into our lives?
The angel said, "You have not obeyed my voice." How does God speak to us when we drift?
A new generation arose who did not know the Lord. How can faith be passed on to the next generation?
God raised up judges because he was moved by their groaning. What does this show about God's compassion?
When the people cried out, God raised up Othniel. What does this show about God's mercy?
God used Ehud, a left-handed man, to deliver Israel. How does God use unexpected people?
Shamgar saved Israel with an oxgoad. What small thing could God use in your hands?
Deborah, a prophetess, judged Israel and passed on God's word to Barak. How does God use people who listen to him?
Barak would only go if Deborah went with him. Where do you need others' faith to strengthen yours?
Deborah said, "Does not the Lord go out before you?" What lies ahead that God goes before you in?
Deborah and Barak sang praise to the Lord. How can you praise God after a victory?
"My heart goes out to the commanders who offered themselves willingly." How can you offer yourself willingly?
"Your friends be like the sun as he rises in his might." What does it mean to love God?
Israel cried out because of the Midianites. What drives you to cry out to God?
The angel called Gideon a "mighty man of valour" while he was hiding. How does God see you differently than you see yourself?
Gideon built an altar and called it "The Lord is Peace." How is God your peace?
Gideon asked for signs with the fleece. How does God patiently help our weak faith?
God reduced Gideon's army so Israel couldn't boast. How does God show his strength through our weakness?
God let Gideon hear the dream to strengthen him. How has God encouraged you when you were afraid?
With trumpets and jars, the Lord gave the victory. How does God win battles in unexpected ways?
Gideon said, "The Lord will rule over you." Who rules your life?
Gideon's ephod became a snare. How can good things become idols?
After Gideon died, Israel forgot God. How quickly do we forget God's goodness?
Abimelech seized power through violence. What does selfish ambition lead to?
Jotham's parable compares Abimelech to a thornbush. What makes a good leader?
God repaid the evil. What does this show about God's justice?
Israel served many gods. What do people serve instead of God?
The people put away their foreign gods, and God could bear their misery no longer. What does this show about God's heart?
Jephthah was rejected by his brothers. How does God use people others reject?
The Spirit of the Lord came on Jephthah. How does God empower people for his work?
Jephthah's rash vow led to tragedy. What does this teach about speaking carefully to God?
Pride and quarrels led to civil war. How can pride divide God's people?
The judges who followed are briefly listed. What does faithful, quiet service look like?
The angel promised Manoah's barren wife a son. How does God work through impossible situations?
Manoah prayed, "Teach us what we are to do with the child." How can you pray for the children in your life?
The angel's name was "wonderful." What does this show about God?
Samson wanted a wife from the Philistines. How can our desires lead us astray?
Samson tore a lion apart by the Spirit's power. What does this show about God's strength?
Samson's riddle led to anger and revenge. How does anger spiral?
Samson took revenge on the Philistines. Why is revenge never satisfying?
The Spirit of the Lord rushed on Samson. How does God's power work through weak people?
Samson was thirsty and called on God, who opened a spring. When have you cried out to God in need?
Delilah was paid to discover Samson's secret. What lures do you need to watch out for?
Samson did not know the Lord had left him. How can we drift from God without noticing?
Samson prayed, "Remember me." What does this show about God hearing even at the end?
Micah made his own idols and priests. What happens when everyone does what is right in their own eyes?
Micah thought hiring a Levite would bring God's blessing. Why can't we buy God's favour?
The Danites sought a place for themselves. Where are you looking for security apart from God?
The Danites stole Micah's idols. What does this show about worthless gods?
They set up idols while the house of God was at Shiloh. Why do people prefer their own ways of worship?
The old man showed hospitality to the traveller. How can you show hospitality?
The horrifying events show how far Israel had fallen. What does this show about our need for God's rescue?
All Israel gathered as one to deal with the crime. Why does God care about justice among his people?
Israel asked God again after defeat. How do you seek God after setbacks?
Israel grieved that one tribe was nearly lost. What does this show about the cost of division?
"Everyone did what was right in his own eyes." How does Judges show our need for a good King?
